notes.title: Balance patch
notes.notes:
Vermithrax:

1500 HP -> 2000 HP
Draconic Dodge: 15 seconds -> 20 seconds

Note: Vermithrax was quite fragile when the enemy knew how to face it. To address this, we significantly increased its hit points, but we reduced its ability to move to control its power.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Now, each player starts with the same cards in hand, namely:

1 card "Bone Corpse"
1 card "Macabre Occultist"
1 card "Howling Skull"
1 card "Unstable Skeleton"

[b]Balancing:[/b]

Passive 2: Steel Bones:
Armored Bone Corpse: 120 HP > 80 HP

Note: We hope to reduce the snowball effect so that players who are behind can more easily come back into the game

notes.title: Balance patch
notes.notes:
Macabre Occultists:

HP: 20 > 25
Range: 6 > 7

Cannon Fodder Bone Corpses:

HP: 25 > 60
Notes: Until now, the bone corpses were too weak, like harmless puppets. To address this, we have administered them HP steroids that should make them formidable adversaries!

notes.title: Balance Update and AI Improvement.
notes.notes:
Following player feedback, we have decided to increase the pace of the games by reducing the overall cost of cards and increasing the movement speed of all units.

Changes:

Howling Skulls :

Spectral Essence Cost: 2 → 1
Movement Speed: 10 units per second → 9 units per second
Number of creatures: 3 > 4

[b]Macabre Occultists:[/b]

Spectral Essence Cost: 3 → 2
Movement Speed: 6 units per second → 7 units per second

[b]Bone Corpses:[/b]

Movement Speed: 4 units per second → 5 units per second

[b]Unstable Skeleton:[/b]

Spectral Essence Cost: 5 → 4
Movement Speed: 4 units per second → 5 units per second

[b]AI Improvement:[/b]
Previously, when the Macabre Occultist targeted a unit that died in the meantime, the mage would shoot into empty space. Now, it dynamically shifts its attack to a target within its range.
Note: It was frustrating for players to see their units charge up an attack only to not attack in the end. Now, the double mage combo should be formidable!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

Fixed a bug that caused Vermithrax to behave incorrectly in front of the enemy throne, preventing it from attacking the warlord.
Fixed a bug that prevented the triggering of sounds when units appeared.

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]

Changed font.

notes.title: Performance improvement and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
- General performance optimization.
- Correction of a bug that caused abnormal behavior for Vermithrax in front of the throne, preventing it from attacking the throne with its basic attacks.
- Correction of a bug that resulted in a continuous reflection effect on the main menu cards. Now, the reflection triggers correctly.
